verses.verse:
निषादद्वय कल्पे तु चतूर्थाशौ भविष्यतः।
गान्धारोभय कल्पे तु पंचमांश भविष्यतः।३४।
verses.text: When the two Niṣādas are made [as separate holes], they will be one-fourth; when both Gāndhāras are made, they will be one-fifth.

commentary.text: If the Niṣādas are divided into two holes, both holes will be a quarter of the paridhimāna (measure of the circumference). If the Gāndhāras are divided into two holes, both holes will be a pañcamāṃśa (one-fifth) of the paridhimāna, 1/5.
